name: [X10 + AURA] CITY NOT MOUNTAIN
desc:
Welcome to NOT A MOUNTAIN TOWN
Cities Not Mountains is an action-packed world with a thrilling urban feel!


Here, you'll experience parkour amid the hustle and bustle of tall buildings, deserted city streets, and stunning urban scenery.

Jump from roof to roof, master challenging tracks, and prove your parkour skills in an arena designed to test players agility and agility.
With a modern city vibe and varied paths, every corner of the map holds new obstacles and challenges to conquer.

Are you ready to conquer this city and become a true parkour master?
